name: DarkeLIB
english_description: The real, original DarkeLIB circa 1999 ("Daybreak Ridge"), a from-scratch English-language Lima/Nightmare/TMI-lineage MudOS mudlib -- the actual ancestor codebase this project's already-onboarded rifts2 (RiftsMUD2) forked into a Rifts-setting reskin. This fork (thraeq/DarkeLIB, 58 commits ahead of the original jpeckham/DarkeLIB) is the community-maintained, more actively FluffOS-adapted branch, with real domain content (arm_dealers, camps, caves, damned, daybreak, diewarzau, drizzt, excelsior, illuminarae, khojem, mines, newbieville, nfd, nocte, shadowraith, soulslayer, warsyn, zortek) and real 1999-2018 development history (in-game news posts, hardcoded staff/admin names) rather than a stock demo. Confirmed genuinely FluffOS/MudOS-compatible (zero driver_hook/H_[A-Z_]+ hits). Onboarding found and fixed a new, severe, previously-uncatalogued bug class (AGENTS.md #7.165): adm/simul_efun/overrides.lpc's message() compatibility shim unconditionally forwarded its optional 4th (exclude) argument even when a caller never supplied one, hard-erroring on this driver's stricter typing for that parameter on the OVERWHELMING MAJORITY of ordinary 3-argument message() calls across the entire codebase -- fixing this ONE function turned a 1363-failure lpcc_check.sh batch sweep into 493 failures in a single pass (out of ~6957 files), by far the single highest-impact fix in this session. Also fixed: another new bug class (AGENTS.md #6.8, the MudOS-era `status` type alias for `int`, unsupported by this driver's lexer, across 10 files); a second confirmed instance of AGENTS.md #7.118's .c-to-.lpc filename-slice-arithmetic bug in daemon/command.lpc's rehash() (every ordinary command silently returned "What?" from the very first boot, identical shape to rifts2's own inherited copy of the same bug); AGENTS.md #7.159-class stale personal-wizard-home-directory path references (a monk.h header, a misery/def.h header, and an entire ~48-file glitch/swamp zone's monster-spawn/item paths, all pointing at content that DOES exist elsewhere in the tree) versus one genuinely-never-archived case left undocumented-but-guarded; a message-class typo ("login" vs "logon") in adm/obj/login.lpc that silently swallowed the new-password rejection/mismatch feedback text entirely (the underlying accept/reject logic already worked, but the player never saw why); the same login.lpc new-password confirmation dialogue also had AGENTS.md #8.19's missing-return bug (a too-short password or mismatched confirmation still silently succeeded); several one-off pre-existing typos/type-mismatches found via lpcc_check.sh and the required LPC formatter idempotency check (unbalanced quotes, a stray #undef swallowing a real inherit statement, a wrong inherited-function name, an array passed where set_ac()/set_smell() require a single string, a variable declared int* used as a 2D mixed* array, a score/scores variable-name typo alongside a scanff/sscanf typo). A whole tinker2 content subtree (systematic 'w'->'d' character substitution corrupting every keyword/identifier/string in ~15 files, confirmed via raw-archive diff, unreferenced by anything reachable) and std/obj/container.lpc (an unfinished, never-inherited generic-container experiment -- the identical dead file rifts2 already documented from the same DarkeLIB ancestry) were left undocumented as genuinely broken/dead upstream content, not invented fixes. Full registration-to-gameplay playthrough verified live and repeatedly with multiple fresh characters (name/password including both the accept and reject paths for a too-short and a mismatched password, race pick, stat assignment, ansi y/n branches, look/score/inventory/who/help/quit all correct, plus a clean reconnect-and-relogin with a previously-saved character). Admin account (fluffos, full (god)/(admin)/(superuser)/(siteadmin)/(assist)/(approval) rank) seeded via this lineage's own data-file mechanism (position field in the saved player file, plus group membership in adm/db/groups.db alongside the archive's original admin, parnell -- a real historical high-level character, left untouched per AGENTS.md #1.5's pre-existing-bootstrap-id convention) and verified live via a wizard `update` command. See libs/darkelib/NOTES.md and AGENTS.md #6.8/#7.165 for the full writeup.
